summary: Tested new Deal Outcomes report screen (/(app)/deal-outcomes) end-to-end. Backend endpoint GET /api/stats/deal-outcomes/list verified via 7 pytest cases (all pass). Frontend UI verified as dealer (dave@fourbuy.co.za) and admin (admin@fourbuy.co.za): tile header + 3 status pills navigate correctly with ?bucket= deep-link params, filter pills switch buckets, conversion percentages render and sum to 100% when >=1 answered, rows render with photo/make/model/year/price/reference, tapping a row navigates to /(app)/vehicle/{id}, and reload (pull-to-refresh equivalent on web) re-fetches successfully. Admin sees larger roll-up (22 pending) than dealer (16 pending) — aggregation confirmed. One minor UX issue: subtitle 'Dealership · last 90 days' is shown even for admin, and the deal-outcomes route is appearing as a bottom-tab entry (should likely be a stack-only route).

issues: Subtitle reads 'Dealership · last 90 days' even for admins — should say 'All dealerships · last 90 days' when role=admin (deal-outcomes.tsx line 113).

The 'Deal Done' pill label wraps onto two lines ("Deal\nDone") at 390px viewport because pills use flex:1 with paddingHorizontal:10 — consider tightening padding or shortening to 'Done' on narrow widths (deal-outcomes.tsx lines 176, 311-321).

The /(app)/deal-outcomes route is showing up as a bottom-tab bar entry (visible as 'deal-outcomes' / 'deal-outc...' pill on both dealer and admin bottom bar). Report screens usually shouldn't appear in the primary tab bar — verify tab layout / route config in /(app)/_layout to hide this route from the tab bar.

action_items: (Minor) Update subtitle to 'All dealerships · last 90 days' when current user is admin.
(Minor) Fix 'Deal Done' pill label wrapping on 390px viewport — reduce paddingHorizontal or use a shorter label.
(Minor) Hide /(app)/deal-outcomes from the bottom tab bar (declare it in the (app) stack but exclude from Tabs). It currently surfaces as a tab item on both dealer + admin views.
critical_code_review_comments: deal-outcomes.tsx uses ScrollView with rows.map — fine for ≤ a few dozen items but consider FlatList if the 90-day window can produce hundreds of rows.

apiFetch failure in load() silently swallows errors (empty catch) — the empty state falls through but a small inline error banner would help dealers know the report failed to load (deal-outcomes.tsx lines 84-94).
seed_data_creation: None — existing seeded data used (dealer 'dave' has 16 pending + 1 deal_done + 0 no_deal in the 90-day window; admin sees 22 pending + 1 deal_done + 0 no_deal aggregate).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deal Outcomes feature (/(app)/deal-outcomes) is fully working — backend /api/stats/deal-outcomes/list returns correct schema and honors role scoping; frontend deep-links via ?bucket=pending|deal_done|no_deal; row taps route to /(app)/vehicle/{id}. Playwright UI login form quirk: text-based SIGN IN click does NOT fire submission — use page.keyboard.press('Enter') after filling password field, that reliably logs in. All bucket pill / tile header / percentage / row-tap testIDs listed in the review request are present and functional.
